about.title: About Protein Calculator - Daily Protein Intake
about.description: The Protein Calculator determines your daily protein needs based on your weight, activity level, and fitness goals. Adequate protein intake is crucial for muscle maintenance, recovery, and overall health. Protein requirements vary significantly based on age, gender, activity level, and specific goals like muscle building or weight loss. This calculator provides personalized recommendations using established nutritional guidelines and sports science research.

faq.q: How much protein do I need per day?
faq.a: Generally 0.8-2.2g per kg of body weight, depending on activity level and goals. Sedentary adults need around 0.8g/kg, while athletes and those building muscle need 1.6-2.2g/kg. The calculator provides personalized recommendations based on your specific profile.

faq.q: Can I get enough protein from plant sources?
faq.a: Yes, plant-based proteins like legumes, quinoa, nuts, seeds, and protein-rich grains can meet protein needs when consumed in adequate amounts and variety. Combining different plant proteins ensures complete amino acid profiles.

faq.q: When should I consume protein for best results?
faq.a: Distribute protein throughout the day, with 20-30g per meal for optimal absorption. Post-workout protein within 2 hours helps with muscle recovery and growth. Morning protein intake can also help with satiety and metabolism.

faq.q: What happens if I eat too much protein?
faq.a: Excess protein is typically converted to energy or stored as fat. Very high intake may strain kidneys in some individuals, but moderate excess is generally safe for healthy people. Focus on meeting your calculated needs rather than excessive intake.
